description: This file contains tests for various helper functions used in a Telegram bot extension, including message reply handling, forwarding context normalization, mention detection, thread parameter building, and forum flag resolution.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumThreadId
methods.description: Determines forum thread ID based on message parameters, returning undefined for non-forum groups, or the thread ID for forum groups.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Resolves whether a chat is a forum based on chat info or fallback to getChat.

methods.name: buildTelegramThreadParams
methods.description: Builds thread parameter object for Telegram API calls based on input ID and scope.

methods.name: buildTelegramRoutingTarget
methods.description: Creates a routing string for Telegram chat and thread targeting based on chat ID and optional thread info.

methods.name: buildTypingThreadParams
methods.description: Constructs thread parameters for typing indicators, normalizing thread IDs.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDirectPeerId
methods.description: Resolves the direct peer ID for Telegram, preferring sender ID if available.

methods.name: normalizeForwardedContext
methods.description: Normalizes different message forwarding contexts into a unified representation.

methods.name: describeReplyTarget
methods.description: Extracts information about the message being replied to, including forwarding context if present, and handles various edge cases.

methods.name: hasBotMention
methods.description: Determines if a message text mentions a specific bot username, considering exact matches and boundaries.

methods.name: expandTextLinks
methods.description: Translates text link entities into Markdown-style links in the message text.
